paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.03, with a 5.98 percent change from the prior close and a -26.55 percent change over a 21-session window.

Recent news headlines include reports of Cetera Investment Advisers raising its stock position in Fermi Inc. and the company expecting to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year. There are also reports of FRMI stock surging nearly 27 percent and then sliding after a $375M convertible note deal.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Insider activity includes one Form 4 filing.
